integrity: Analytical proof using support curvature, exact spherical moments and an all-order positive polynomial, with supplementary finite independent checks.
scientific_limitations: Exact Santaló product and all-order monotonicity only for the cubic threefold-projection support family. The convexity cutoff is known separately; global priority remains subject to historical sources. No general volume-product stability theorem is claimed.
title: Strict Santaló-volume monotonicity for the cubic threefold-projection exception
